data.title: 朝田诗乃 · 玻璃海滩的耳机假日
data.description: 诗乃穿着蓝灰运动泳装，坐在折叠沙滩椅上调试防水耳机；她把一只耳机递向镜头分享海浪声，另一只手压住被风吹起的短外套，眼神比游戏里更放松。
data.action: 沙滩椅上调试防水耳机，把一只耳机递向镜头分享海浪声
data.lighting: soft afternoon sun reflected on calm water
data.mood: 脱离任务后的轻松连接
data.promptProse: Seated in the folding chair, she offers one waterproof earpiece toward the viewer with one hand and holds down her windbreaker with the other. Afternoon light catches the pebbles beside the calm water.
data.animaCaption: One hand offers the earpiece while the other holds down her windbreaker.
